description:
The proposal seeks pre-application advice for a scheme involving extensions and alterations to an existing mixed-use building comprising a 
ground floor commercial unit with residential flats above. The proposed works include: -The erection of two rear extensions at first floor level, including a rear extension attached to the main building and a separate two-storey rear extension above the existing commercial unit 
forming part of a duplex residential unit. -The erection of a dormer roof extension at third floor level above the main building. -Internal reconfiguration of the upper floors to increase the number of self-contained residential units from two to four (Use Class C3). -The enclosure of an existing rear patio area beneath the proposed first-floor extension, forming approximately 10 sqm of additional 
internal space to the ground floor commercial unit. Formation of a roof covering over the existing patio area between Nos. 140 and 150 Upper Street to accommodate the relocation of existing air-conditioning units within a screened enclosure. -Replacement of an existing glazed door with a window and insertion of additional windows to the side elevation. -Associated internal alterations and provision of 
private amenity space.
